Title: How distance to jobs affects employment outcomes of MSF program clients in Singapore
Description: This project was done as part of my internship with the Ministry of Social and Family Development. This project looks at how travel distance to location of employment could impact employment outcomes.

Title: Community Mapping of Environmental Conservation Zones in Thailand
Description: This project was done in collaboration between NUS, IMPECT, and the village of Ban Mae Yang Min in Chiang Mai. The map was created in order to help fight for land rights and government recognition of the village's efforts in conservation.
